FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Wire.mn QPay, bank transfer, and 4K playback
FAQ.q1: How does payment work with Wire.mn and QPay?
FAQ.a1: Selecting your plan redirects to the official Wire.mn hosted checkout. You can scan the QPay QR code with any Mongolian banking app (Khan Bank, Golomt, TDB, XacBank, SocialPay). Payments verify within seconds via signed webhooks.
FAQ.q2: How do I pay using direct Khan Bank transfer?
FAQ.a2: Select 'Direct Bank Transfer' at checkout. Send the exact plan amount to Khan Bank Account 5132104221 (Holder: sukhbat munkh-orgil) with your order ID in the transaction memo. Fill out the instant confirmation form to activate your subscription.
FAQ.q3: Are there automated recurring charges or auto-renewals?
FAQ.a3: No. AI MOVIE never automatically charges your account. Each month requires an explicit customer order and payment approval.
FAQ.q4: Which devices support 4K Ultra HD streaming?
FAQ.a4: The Premium tier supports Smart TVs (Apple TV, Samsung, LG, Android TV), laptops, tablets, and phones with 4K HDR playback and Dolby Atmos spatial audio across up to 4 concurrent streams.
